scope: Real staging chat (delivery order, agent on): a full name whose last surname is also a place keyword was saved as the delivery address and quoted (fee 2.000 → 5.000) while the name was requested again; a complex name sent after the WhatsApp location pin replaced the pin; «¿por qué sube el domicilio…?» was answered with the name prompt and «No entiendo porque sube todo eso» was saved as the customer name
trigger: Real chat pasted by the user on 21/10 (personal data not copied; synthetic names and places in tests)
whatWentWell: Family list with descriptions for the fried-chicken question, pick by number and option prompt
Drink option with a kitchen note («que esté fría»), arepa option change, closing with «así está bien gracias»
Location pin quoted by route distance; cash payment, confirmation and ETA answer after the order
baselineFindings: Root cause: «torres», «plaza», «iglesia», «san X», «santa» and coverage-zone words match the landmark keywords anywhere in the text, so «<Nombre> <Apellido> Torres» was an address-only message, a plausible address and an address replacement; the agent's own shortcut turns such a message into set_address, and with a pending option the deterministic address path takes it too (reproduced: «Domicilio anotado: _<name>_», fee 5.000)
Pin then «Agrupación bosques de Castilla» / «Conjunto Torres del Parque»: the pin and its coordinates were replaced by the complex name and quoted again
Fee complaints at the name or payment step: no explanation; at the name step a long complaint could be taken as the name
The exact production path for the name at the name step could not be replayed with the simulated model; the shared root cause was reproduced deterministically
fix: looksLikePersonNameNotPlace (2–4 letter-only words, no prepositions/articles/address nouns, first word not a place head or coverage zone, a later word is a place keyword) blocks looksLikeAddressOnlyMessage, the landmark detectors behind isPlausibleDeliveryAddress / looksLikeAddressReplacement and the name-rejection check; a confirmed pin keeps its coordinates and fee and appends a complex or landmark name as a reference («📍 … — <reference>», «Anoté la referencia … junto a tu ubicación») unless the new text is a street with a number; isDeliveryFeeChangeQuestion («por qué sube/cobran … domicilio», «no entiendo por qué sube todo eso») answers with the current address, route km and fee (or the fixed fee) and repeats the open step.
